      'constraints',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(c.conname,c.convalidated,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true)) ORDER BY c.conname) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contypid=t.oid),'[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY t.typname)
      FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND t.typname=ANY($4::text[]) AND (t.typtype IN ('e','d') OR (t.typtype='c' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid=t.typrelid AND c.relkind='c')))),'[]'::jsonb),
    'schemas',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',n.nspname,
      'owner',pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),'acl',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor),CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END,x.privilege_type,x.is_grantable) ORDER BY x.grantor::regrole::text,x.grantee::regrole::text,x.privilege_type) FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(n.nspacl,acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) x),'[]'::jsonb),'effectiveAcl',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(r,
        has_schema_privilege(r,n.oid,'USAGE'),has_schema_privilege(r,n.oid,'CREATE')) ORDER BY r)
        FROM unnest($3::text[]) r WHERE EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=r))) ORDER BY n.nspname)
      FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','extensions','auth')),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS catalog

SELECT jsonb_build_object('schemaOid','public'::regnamespace::oid,'schemaOwner',(SELECT pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid='public'::regnamespace),'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',r.oid,'name',r.rolname,'login',r.rolcanlogin,'inherit',r.rolinherit,'super',r.rolsuper,'createRole',r.rolcreaterole,'createDb',r.rolcreatedb,'replication',r.rolreplication,'bypassRls',r.rolbypassrls,'limit',r.rolconnlimit,'config',r.rolconfig,'validUntil',r.rolvaliduntil::text,'passwordNull',a.rolpassword IS NULL) ORDER BY r.rolname) FROM pg_roles r JOIN pg_authid a USING(oid) WHERE r.rolname=ANY($1::text[])),'memberships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(m.roleid),pg_get_userbyid(m.member),pg_get_userbyid(m.grantor),m.admin_option,m.inherit_option,m.set_option) ORDER BY m.roleid,m.member),'[]') FROM pg_auth_members m WHERE m.roleid IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=ANY($1::text[])) OR m.member IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=ANY($1::text[]))),'objects',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(class,oid,name) ORDER BY class,name) FROM (SELECT 'relation' class,c.oid,n.nspname||'.'||c.relname name FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','auth','extensions') UNION ALL SELECT 'function',p.oid,p.oid::regprocedure::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','auth','extensions') UNION ALL SELECT 'type',t.oid,n.nspname||'.'||t.typname FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','auth','extensions')) o)) d
